props.name: children
props.description: Ordered `Resizable.Panel` and `Resizable.Handle` children.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial panel sizes for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the resizable component is disabled.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier for the resizable root.

props.name: keyboardDelta
props.description: The amount to resize when using keyboard shortcuts.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback when panel sizes change. Values are in pixels.

props.name: onHandleKeyDown
props.type: (context: { event: KeyboardEvent handleIndex: number sizes: number[] }) => void
props.description: Callback when a key is pressed on a handle.

props.name: onResizeEnd
props.description: Callback when a resize operation ends. Values are in pixels.

props.name: onResizeStart
props.description: Callback when a resize operation starts. Values are in pixels.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Axis along which panels resize.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled panel sizes. Numbers are pixels; percentage strings are relative to the root.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the panel.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Whether the panel is collapsible.

props.name: collapsibleMin
props.description:
Size of the panel when collapsed. Only applies when `collapsible` is true.
- Use string as percent, like `20%`
- Use number as px, like `328`

props.name: max
props.description:
Maximum size of the panel.
- Use string as percent, like `20%`
- Use number as px, like `328`

props.name: min
props.description:
Minimum size of the panel.
- Use string as percent, like `20%`
- Use number as px, like `328`

props.name: onCollapse
props.description: Callback when the panel is collapsed. Size is in pixels.

props.name: onExpand
props.description: Callback when the panel is expanded. Size is in pixels.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Whether the panel is resizable.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: action
props.description: Handle interaction behavior.

props.name: children
props.description:
Content or render function receiving the live handle state.
A render function must declare its parameter, even when unused. A zero-argument
function is called as an accessor and is not mounted as a component.

props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: intersection
props.description: Whether this handle participates in intersection resizing.
